cues.pt: In 2003, NASA sent two robotic explorers to Mars: Spirit and Opportunity.
cues.en: In 2003, NASA sent two robotic explorers to Mars: Spirit and Opportunity.

cues.pt: Their mission was to search the rocks for traces of a past with liquid water.
cues.en: Their mission was to search the rocks for traces of a past with liquid water.

cues.pt: Mars Global Surveyor mapped the planet's surface, helping NASA pinpoint two promising landing sites.
cues.en: Mars Global Surveyor mapped the planet's surface, helping NASA pinpoint two promising landing sites.

cues.pt: Meridiani Planum, rich in hematite, which only typically forms in liquid water.
cues.en: Meridiani Planum, rich in hematite, which only typically forms in liquid water.

cues.pt: And Gusev Crater, a massive basin that once looked like an ancient lake.
cues.en: And Gusev Crater, a massive basin that once looked like an ancient lake.

cues.pt: Em janeiro de 2004, chegaram a lados opostos de Marte.
cues.en: In January 2004, they reached opposite sides of Mars.

cues.pt: O módulo protegia cada rover. Os airbags amorteceram a chegada.
cues.en: Each rover rode inside a lander. Airbags cushioned the arrival.

cues.pt: Opportunity parou dentro da pequena cratera Eagle.
cues.en: Opportunity came to rest inside tiny Eagle Crater.

cues.pt: Depois das verificações, chegou a hora de explorar.
cues.en: After the checks, it was time to explore.

cues.pt: No afloramento claro, pequenas esferas chamam a atenção.
cues.en: Small spheres stand out in the pale rock outcrop.

cues.pt: Estão soltas no chão e presas dentro da rocha.
cues.en: Some lie loose on the ground; others are embedded in rock.

cues.pt: As medições identificaram hematita: as famosas blueberries.
cues.en: Measurements identified hematite: the famous blueberries.

cues.pt: Mas uma pista não basta. Vamos examinar o interior da rocha.
cues.en: One clue is not enough. Let's examine the rock beneath its surface.

cues.pt: A RAT esmerilha a camada externa e revela material menos alterado.
cues.en: The RAT grinds away the outer layer, revealing less altered material.

cues.pt: A ferramenta prepara a amostra. Outros instrumentos fazem as medições.
cues.en: The tool prepares the sample. Other instruments take the measurements.

cues.pt: O APXS encontrou muito enxofre, associado a sais de sulfato.
cues.en: APXS found abundant sulfur, associated with sulfate salts.

cues.pt: O Mössbauer identificou jarosita, um mineral ligado à ação da água.
cues.en: Mössbauer identified jarosite, a mineral linked to water's action.

cues.pt: Camadas, concreções e composição química contam a mesma história.
cues.en: Layers, concretions and chemistry tell the same story.

cues.pt: Evidências fortes: água líquida alterou estas rochas há muito tempo.
cues.en: Strong evidence: liquid water altered these rocks long ago.

cues.pt: Os 90 sóis terminaram. Em abril de 2004, ambas continuavam trabalhando.
cues.en: Their 90 sols were complete. In April 2004, both kept working.

cues.pt: 2005. O caminho reencontrou uma peça da chegada.
cues.en: 2005. The journey crossed paths with a piece of the arrival.

cues.pt: Este escudo enfrentou o calor da entrada e foi descartado na descida.
cues.en: This shield faced the heat of entry, then separated during descent.

cues.pt: E esta rocha metálica? De onde ela veio?
cues.en: What about this metallic rock? Where did it come from?

cues.pt: Ferro e níquel. Uma visitante de fora de Marte.
cues.en: Iron and nickel. A visitor from beyond Mars.

cues.pt: Heat Shield Rock: o primeiro meteorito identificado em outro planeta.
cues.en: Heat Shield Rock: the first meteorite identified on another planet.

cues.pt: Tempestades cobrem regiões imensas. Algumas acabam envolvendo todo o planeta.
cues.en: Dust storms cover vast regions. Some eventually surround the whole planet.

cues.pt: Em 2007, a poeira bloqueou a luz. Era hora de conservar energia.
cues.en: In 2007, dust blocked the light. It was time to conserve energy.

cues.pt: Atividades suspensas. Menos comunicações. A espera durou semanas.
cues.en: Activities stopped. Communications were reduced. The wait lasted weeks.

cues.pt: O céu clareou. A Opportunity voltou ao trabalho.
cues.en: The sky cleared. Opportunity returned to work.

cues.pt: Em 2005, Spirit escalou Husband Hill: uma primeira vez em outro planeta.
cues.en: In 2005, Spirit climbed Husband Hill: a first on another planet.

cues.pt: Em Comanche, carbonatos apontavam para água antiga menos ácida.
cues.en: At Comanche, carbonates pointed to ancient, less acidic water.

cues.pt: Uma roda travada revelou sílica: pistas de fontes termais ou vapor.
cues.en: A stuck wheel exposed silica: clues to hot springs or steam.

cues.pt: Em Home Plate, camadas guardavam evidências de explosões vulcânicas.
cues.en: At Home Plate, layers held evidence of volcanic explosions.

cues.pt: Mais de seis anos de trabalho. 7,73 quilômetros de descobertas.
cues.en: More than six years of work. 7.73 kilometres of discoveries.

cues.pt: Em Troy, atolou. Em 2010, virou uma estação de pesquisa fixa.
cues.en: At Troy, it became stuck. In 2010, it became a stationary science platform.

cues.pt: Mal inclinada para o inverno, provavelmente perdeu a luta contra o frio.
cues.en: Poorly tilted for winter, it probably lost its struggle against the cold.

cues.pt: Spirit não respondeu mais. A busca terminou em 2011.
cues.en: Spirit never answered again. The search ended in 2011.

cues.pt: Em 2018, a pergunta era outra: o que esculpiu Perseverance Valley? Água, lama ou vento?
cues.en: In 2018, a new question: what carved Perseverance Valley? Water, debris flows or wind?

cues.pt: Sua energia vem do Sol. Vamos registrar quanta luz consegue atravessar o céu.
cues.en: Your power comes from the Sun. Let's record how much light reaches through the sky.

cues.pt: Esta observação serve de referência para a próxima comparação.
cues.en: This observation provides a reference for the next comparison.

cues.pt: Registre o vale. Cada imagem pode guardar uma pergunta para o futuro.
cues.en: Record the valley. Each image can hold a question for the future.

cues.pt: A poeira voltou. Desta vez, a tempestade acabaria envolvendo Marte inteiro.
cues.en: The dust returned. This time, the storm would grow to surround all of Mars.

cues.pt: O Sol está mais fraco na imagem. A poeira impede a luz de chegar.
cues.en: The Sun is fainter in the image. Dust is stopping its light from reaching us.

cues.pt: Se esta for a última chance, que imagem devemos guardar?
cues.en: If this is our last chance, which image should we keep?

cues.pt: Em 10 de junho de 2018, chegou o último sinal.
cues.en: On June 10, 2018, the last signal arrived.

cues.pt: Projetada para 90 sóis, explorou Marte por quase quinze anos.
cues.en: Built for 90 sols, it explored Mars for almost fifteen years.

cues.pt: Percorreu 45,16 quilômetros: um recorde fora da Terra na época.
cues.en: It travelled 45.16 kilometres: an off-Earth record at the time.

cues.pt: Em fevereiro de 2019, após meses de tentativas, a missão foi encerrada.
cues.en: In February 2019, after months of trying, the mission was declared complete.

cues.pt: As gêmeas continuam em Marte. O que aprenderam chegou muito mais longe.
cues.en: The twins remain on Mars. What they taught us travelled much farther.

texts.en: Compare the Sun through the dust

texts.pt: Hematita · no solo e na rocha
texts.en: Hematite · on the ground and in the rock
